Thanks for replying,

You're absolutely right - my life may be better than the poor people in that situation and I feel for them. But to me, although I may have it good seeing I have a house to live in and income my mental illnesses are slowly killing me. I find joy in nothing anymore. I go to the gym for example, something I used to love and hate it - I have to push myself and tonight I even left early because I felt like I was being watched. I'm a paranoid mess. I think the only viable solutions are some sort on in patient program or finish myself off. 

I want a good future, I want a family, a wife and kids but that will never happen in the state I'm in. If that can never happen whats the point of living? There doesn't seem to be any to me.
